name: Network Diagram

blocks.description: Sample precedence diagram read left to right: Start to A; A to B and A to C (edge labelled FS-2d); B to D (edge labelled +2d); C to E; E to F (SS, drawn from the start of E to the start of F); D and E to G; G to H (FF, drawn from the finish of G to the finish of H); H to I; I and F to End. Nodes are rounded boxes, no time axis.

legend:
In this network diagram:
There is a two-day lead between the completion of A and beginning of C.
There is a two-day lag between the completion of B and beginning of D.
There is a start-to-start relationship between E and F.
There is a finish-to-finish relationship between G and H.

All other relationships are finish-to-start.
notes: Landscape page. The diagram and legend are a worked sample, not fields: the activities A to I are placeholders for the project's own activities. Keep the printed edge notation (FS-2d for a lead, +2d for a lag, SS, FF) when drawing the project's network. There is no Document Element table for this form.
